resources.string: Locks the apps you choose behind your fingerprint, face, or screen lock

Bio Key uses this service to see which app is on screen, so it can cover apps you\'ve chosen to lock until you authenticate. When you tap something on the home screen, in its search or in Recents, it reads its label, so a locked app is covered before it opens. While Recents is open and a locked app is unlocked, it reads the app names on the Recents cards, so closing that app there locks it again. It reads the title of each new window, to tell Google Password Manager\'s screens from sign-in sheets over other apps. It can press Home or Back for you to leave a locked app you didn\'t unlock, lock the screen when you ask after too many failed attempts, and open a locked app\'s picture-in-picture window full screen so it can be covered.\n\nBio Key does not read what you type, does not record the screen, and has no internet access. Nothing it observes leaves your device, unless you share BioKey\'s diagnostic log.
